column1: The following three pages summarize key highlights of our environmental initiatives
discussed in this report. They provide a snapshot of our performance to date as well
as our targets going forward. Together, they demonstrate how we’re strengthening
our business by reducing the environmental impact of our operations and working
to empower people everywhere to live more sustainably.
For a more complete overview of our performance over time, see the
environmental data tables and charts on pages 64 to 67.
